name: Sleep medicine & CPAP (category guide)
summary: Home sleep studies vs in-lab PSG — ENT/dental device cross-sells, CPAP machine rental vs buy, and insurer pre-auth traps for foreigners.
body: Snoring and daytime fatigue threads often jump straight to a CPAP shop; start with whether you need a diagnostic sleep study (home polygraphy vs attended polysomnography) ordered by a sleep physician, ENT, or respiratory specialist. Foreigners pay unsubsidised public rates, so private labs sell scheduling speed. Mandibular advancement devices and septoplasty pitches are adjacent products — get the AHI/diagnosis in writing before bundling dental or surgical quotes. CPAP machines may be rented during titration then purchased; ask about mask-fit revisits, filter costs, and travel adapters. Group plans often need pre-authorisation for sleep studies and may classify CPAP as durable medical equipment with separate caps. Pair with adult orthodontics only when jaw surgery / bite correction is explicitly on the table. Category guide, not a ranked sleep-lab list.
